overallConfidence ties go to the larger p50 then the earlier component; a null-p50 component has an unknown share and always counts; a TRD with no auto tasks is confidence none, nothing to judge is n/a

58-08: estimate wave --done and finish read only the stored run state (the wave's p50/p90 and the execution wall that start stored), so they need no calibration; a state for another objective, a finished one or one idle over 12 hours is no live run

decisions.summary: 58-08: every estimate verb exits 0 with 'No estimate: <reason>' (available: false) when the calibration is unusable, never a number; the JSON is rounded once by roundResult from the raw result, the text by each formatter from the same raw result, with line on every result and table on objective and milestone
decisions.rationale: Rounding a rounded figure shifts edge cases; a missing calibration is an answer, not a failure
